rationale: emailservice latency-90 rose from 0.0046 to 0.132 (+2769%, z=+554) and latency-50 rose +877%, while its CPU, memory and socket metrics fell and no other series moved meaningfully, which fits an injected delay rather than resource exhaustion. emailservice is a callee of checkoutservice, and checkoutservice and frontend show error spans in the worst traces. The traces do not list emailservice itself, and the logs contain no usable lines, so the link is indirect.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate and remove the source of added latency on emailservice (check network delay/traffic shaping rules or recent changes on its pod/node), and restart or reschedule the emailservice pod if a delay injection is found. Consider a timeout or async email call in checkoutservice to limit impact.
